parsed.explanation: No explicit presentation offence or capital penalty is documented, but state-directed targeting is sustained and rising: 299 detention decisions in 2025, police stops of trans women in shops/cafes for ID/background documentation, and raids/investigations of support organisations. The government frames trans people as a threat to children/family, with no anti-discrimination protection. If detained, placement is by registered sex with segregation, strip searches, isolation and ineffective complaints, culminating in a trans prisoner found dead in Dec 2025 with delayed investigation and no witness statements. A 2024 knifing where the victim was referred for arrest while the perpetrator was released, plus 3 hate killings among 6 anti-LGBTQ deaths in 2025, show police/state impunity rather than protection. This is organised coercion with severe custody consequences, below criminalising regimes at 0.15 but well above unremedied-exclusion cases.
